# Welcome to Antigravity eXtension (`agx`) Discussions!

We are excited to have you in the **agx** community. This space is dedicated to:
- Sharing best practices for Antigravity session backups and state portability.
- Showcasing custom agent skills (`.agents/skills`) and MCP server integrations.
- Asking usage questions and getting community support.
- Discussing roadmap directions and architectural proposals.

## Getting Started

- Check our [Documentation](https://github.com/imsaba16/agx/tree/main/docs) for technical guides.
- Review [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/imsaba16/agx/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) to get involved in development.
- Please adhere to our [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/imsaba16/agx/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
